messages:
anya (Partnerships): FYI partner CloudLane pinged earlier — they want us live in two additional regions next month (eu-central-2 and ap-northeast-3). Asking about marketplace SKUs + quota approvals. Can we align on next steps?

mike (Cloud Eng): @anya can you paste CloudLane's desired capacity numbers? we need GPUs, instance types, VPC peering notes.

anya (Partnerships): They sent this in the email: 
- eu-central-2: 4x A100/80GB reserved for Dedicated + marketplace listing
- ap-northeast-3: 3x A10G (in burst pool) for hosted failover
- target go-live: 2026-04-20
They want marketplace SKUs active same day.

sophia (Sales): We already have a LOI from a customer in EU who will sign once eu-central-2 is available, so timelines are tight.

li (GTM): For marketplace listing we need partner SKU, pricing band, and technical validation doc. CloudLane said they can provide SKU metadata by EOD tomorrow.

mike (Cloud Eng): Ok. Technical checklist I need: expected peak concurrent inference sessions, typical seq length, KV cache persistence requirements. Also whether they need private deployment images for Private (air-gapped).

anya (Partnerships): I'll extract details from their form tonight. They marked peak concurrency 120 sessions and average seq length 512. No air-gapped images requested for now.

amanda (Legal): Heads-up — marketplace contracts will need our standard reseller appendix + partner data processing addendum. If they're enabling Dedicated reserved capacity that needs a SOW. ETA for review: 3 business days after we get the draft.

mike (Cloud Eng): For quotas: I'll open support requests with AWS and GCP for quota increases and reserved allocation by tomorrow morning. Can @anya drop the account IDs and Marketplace partner IDs? I need project numbers for GCP.

anya (Partnerships): Pasting two IDs: GCP proj-4347-eu, AWS acct 901-xx-433. CloudLane partner ID: CL-7789.

deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule a dry-run deploy 48h before go-live. Use /schedule-deploy eu-central-2 2026-04-18 10:00Z

mike (Cloud Eng): Note on instance types — A100/80GB needs special PCIe drivers and kernel 5.10+. We'll spin a validation build next week and run perf smoke tests. I'll attach results to the ticket.

li (GTM): For announcement coordination: suggest a soft partner blog + Marketplace listing day-of, joint press only after 2 enterprise signups close. Draft timeline: 
- 2026-04-05: Marketplace draft live (internal)
- 2026-04-12: validation complete
- 2026-04-18: dry run
- 2026-04-20: marketplace/soft announcement

anya (Partnerships): Action items I'm tracking: 1) Get SKU metadata from CloudLane (due EOD tomorrow) 2) Share account/project IDs with Mike (done) 3) Amanda to review contract (pending) 4) Li to draft marketplace copy (in flight) 5) Mike to open quota/reservation tickets (in flight)

mike (Cloud Eng): Opening tickets now, I'll cc this thread and put ticket numbers here when created.

amanda (Legal): I'll block time 2026-04-07 to 04-09 for contract review; if they send the draft sooner I can prioritize.

sophia (Sales): Quick ask — can we get a temporary demo tenant in eu-central-2 for the EU prospect? even a pre-prod endpoint will help close.

mike (Cloud Eng): We can expose a pre-prod endpoint on the reserved pool once validation passes. Leave a note in the ticket, I'll annotate access rules.

anya (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll follow up with CloudLane now and push for the SKU metadata and their marketplace legal contacts. Will update with ticket numbers and draft copy here. :rocket:
